logical_floor.meaning: One walkable logical floor section and one actor/object anchor.

corridor_bands.meaning: A rectangular passage with independently measured length, doorway thickness, and margins within the adjoining room walls.
corridor_bands.centering: A passage is centered only when opposing margins match at both ends; unequal margins are valid offset openings.
corridor_bands.routing: One-section approved junction resolvers remain unchanged. Multi-section bands retain literal directional-wall composition until separately approved.

elevation.meaning: A non-negative height stored separately for each occupied floor section.
elevation.connectivity: Cardinally connected sections at equal positive height form one platform.
elevation.actor_anchor: Logical actor anchors remain unchanged by elevation.

projection.visual_model: nested Grammar v2 shell shifted to the platform logical origin
projection.face_clearing: North underside and south hanging-face rows clear buried lower-floor lattice before platform glyphs compose.
projection.top_lattice: The platform top retains lattice points derived from its own occupied footprint.
projection.next_after_corridors: Resume platform visual approval after wide and offset corridor openings are resolved.

lattice.meaning: A shared interior intersection surrounded by four occupied floor sections.

east_cap.rule: An underside terminating into an east-wall face reserves one recessed blank column before the face slash.
